name: Vector Field
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: Which way a quantity increases across the tissue, as arrows over the section. Gene, cell type or any annotation column — with every arrow that could be noise removed.

params.name: source
params.label: Differentiate

options.label: One level of a categorical column

params.help: Selects whether the field represents the local proportion of a population, a continuous measurement, or gene expression.

params.name: field
params.label: Categorical column
params.help:
Selects the categorical annotation used to define the populations.
Used only when Differentiate is set to category.
Defaults to the dataset’s cell-type column.

params.name: level
params.label: Level
params.help: Selects the population from the chosen categorical column whose local proportion is analyzed.

params.name: column
params.label: Continuous column
params.help:
Selects the continuous measurement to analyze.
Used only when Differentiate is set to continuous.

params.name: gene
params.label: Gene
params.help:
Selects the gene whose normalized expression is analyzed.
Used only when Differentiate is set to gene.
Values are normalized to a total of 10,000 counts per cell.

params.name: sigma
params.label: Smoothing (σ, grid cells)
params.help:
Sets the width of the Gaussian smoothing in grid cells.
Larger values produce smoother fields with broader, weaker gradients.

params.name: detail
params.label: Grid detail
params.help:
Sets the spatial resolution of the calculation.
Higher values capture finer but noisier spatial changes.

params.name: arrows
params.label: Arrows
params.help:
Sets the approximate number of arrows displayed.
This changes the display density, not the calculated field.

params.name: gate
params.label: Hide arrows that are not significant
params.help:
Shows only positions with z ≥ 3 and at least 30 effective cells.
Turning it off also displays gradients that may reflect noise.
